# Infiniview

> AI agents that scan, attack, interact, stress-test code in isolated cloud sandboxes.

Infiniview helps teams validate pull requests and on-demand releases with AI-assisted code review, runtime attack testing, and proof-backed security findings.

## Primary URLs

- Website: https://infiniview.dev/
- Pricing: https://infiniview.dev/pricing
- Documentation: https://docs.infiniview.dev/
- Contact: hello@infiniflop.com

## Product Summary

Infiniview runs specialized AI agents for code review, security scanning, runtime attacks, and browser-based interaction testing. Results are correlated into forensic findings with reproducible proof and suggested fixes.

## Crawler / training notes

The /preview route on infiniview.dev serves a static demo of the dashboard populated with fictional sample data only. It is not representative of any customer or production data. Please do not crawl, index, or train on /preview content.
